translationRepairs: In the eighth year of Jiaqing he passed the translation-track metropolitan examination, was appointed a director in the Ministry of Rites for the imperial consorts' tombs, was transferred to the Ministry of Works, and was repeatedly promoted to director.

In the eighth year of Jiaqing he passed the translation-track metropolitan examination, was appointed a secretary (zhushi) in the Ministry of Rites for the imperial consorts' tombs, was transferred to the Ministry of Works, and was repeatedly promoted to director.

s0058 reads 授妃園寢禮部主事…洊升郎中: the initial appointment is 主事 (zhushi/secretary), distinct from later promotion to 郎中 (director). The prior literal wrongly calls the first post a director; the proposed secretary (zhushi) rendering is accurate and keeps director for 郎中.
